lesson.summary: Orchestrator wrap-up must archive at every level the host tracks, and leave a handoff for unfinished work
lesson.synthesized_rule: When an orchestrator seat winds down supervised work (a human says pause/wrap up), archiving a worker's chat/session is not the same as archiving its workspace — a host may track status at both levels independently, and leaving the workspace level unarchived makes finished work look still-active in any fleet view. Archive both. For any workstream that is genuinely unfinished (not merged, not approved), write a durable handoff artifact before archiving the context that held it, naming: what's done, what's not, the human's last feedback verbatim, and the specific next action — so a cold resume (a different session, a different person) doesn't have to re-derive context from a conversation it wasn't part of.
lesson.target_hint: plugins/flow/skills/handoff/SKILL.md (archive-safety check) and/or plugins/flow/skills/orchestrate/SKILL.md (fleet wind-down guidance)
